meaning: Research backlog informed by the integrated second expansion. These are remaining evidence and coverage tasks, not verified recommendations or a claim that the taxonomy is complete. Counts describe the reviewed snapshot; generated coverage and refresh reports remain authoritative.

priorities.area: FPGA, RTL and HDL toolchain validation
tasks: Verify exact FPGA board and silicon support across Yosys/nextpnr architecture databases and vendor suites
Reproduce one complete Verilog and one VHDL flow from source through bitstream generation and programming
Compare HDL language subsets, simulator semantics, formal engines and waveform formats with fixed fixtures
Record vendor edition, device family, host OS and license constraints separately
priorities.next_evidence: A sourced initial catalog now covers Yosys, nextpnr, GHDL, Icarus Verilog, Verilator, cocotb, SBY, GTKWave, OSS CAD Suite, Vivado and Quartus Prime Lite. These are documentation-level product records, not board-tested compatibility claims. Next select representative supported boards and preserve exact tool versions, device databases, synthesis logs, timing reports, bitstream hashes and safe programming acceptance. Experimental architecture backends and proprietary IP remain explicit limitations.

tasks: Resolve uncertain current licensing and distribution pricing
Check dated maintenance and successor projects
Verify current installer routes and supported host versions
priorities.next_evidence: The current catalog already includes communication, radio, bioinformatics, BIM/CAM, industrial control and business workflows. Use the generated refresh queue to select unresolved fields across these records. Recheck the exact license, release or platform document; a reachable homepage does not establish current maintenance, a free distribution, or compatibility.

tasks: Compare additional candidates for cleanup, startup inventory and client-server backup
Deepen screen magnification, accessible reading, document question answering and data cleaning
Add peers for specialized scientific measurement and control tasks
priorities.next_evidence: The integrated review has 102 single-application categories; 34 of the original 112 singleton categories gained alternatives. Use expansion-progress.json and the refresh queue for current totals and identities. Preserve the cleanup library, including unranked and excluded research; do not promote a candidate merely to increase a category count.

priorities.area: Installed workflow, accessibility and resource measurements
tasks: Reproduce complete task workflows on supported operating systems
Measure startup, memory, storage and task completion with declared inputs
Exercise keyboard access, screen readers and recovery from failed operations
priorities.next_evidence: Most recommendations are documentation-based. Establish public or licensed fixtures, pinned versions, equivalent outputs and reproducible environments before asserting lightweight, faster or more reliable choices. The existing grep/ripgrep experiment is scoped to its tested versions, workload and environment; it does not rank unrelated applications.

tasks: Compare messaging and conference workflows across desktop clients
Verify account, server and identity requirements
Test export, retention and free-plan limits
priorities.next_evidence: Desktop chat, protocol clients, team communication and conferencing now have comparison sets. Next verify complete account-to-account workflows, supported interoperability and data portability. Client availability does not establish end-to-end encryption, retention guarantees or every hosted plan feature.

priorities.area: Radio hardware and signal workflow validation
tasks: Match SDR receivers to supported hardware and drivers
Reproduce digital decoding and logging handoffs
Verify device programming, packet radio and satellite data formats
priorities.next_evidence: SDR, amateur radio, RF analysis and satellite workflows now have sourced entries and guides. Compare hardware generations, firmware, driver requirements and operating-system packages; distinguish reception, offline signal analysis and any licensed transmission requirements. Follow documented end-of-life and successor-project notices.

tasks: Compare sequence analysis and phylogenetic workflows with known inputs
Check genomic visualization format limits and reproducible installation
Research laboratory information management and electronic lab notebooks
priorities.next_evidence: Sequence, alignment, phylogeny and genome visualization coverage is established in this expansion. Next use reference datasets and exact program versions to verify workflow compatibility. Dedicated laboratory record systems remain a research lead, with deployment, data portability and access-control evidence needed before inclusion.

priorities.area: BIM, building simulation and manufacturing interchange
tasks: Compare IFC import/export and model review round trips
Validate building-energy and lighting model exchange
Test CAM postprocessors, nesting and CNC handoffs on safe fixtures
priorities.next_evidence: BIM, building analysis, CAM, nesting and machine-control records now exist. Verify complete workflows and their edition, platform, machine and postprocessor constraints. A supported file extension does not prove a lossless round trip; a simulator does not establish a safe real-machine program.

priorities.area: Audio quality, restoration and delivery comparisons
tasks: Compare recorded dialogue restoration on licensed samples
Measure live microphone filtering with supported routing
Verify loudness delivery, plug-in formats and standalone availability
priorities.next_evidence: The catalog now distinguishes documented recorded-audio restoration from live input suppression and supplies conditional setup notes. Add controlled sample, latency and quality comparisons, retaining raw measurements and artifacts. Confirm edition-specific modules and the microphone, host, model and plug-in configuration used.

tasks: Compare robot simulation and offline programming workflows
Verify PLC languages, supported controllers and deployment terms
Research FPGA design and HDL simulation or verification
priorities.next_evidence: Robot, PLC and factory-simulation comparison sets now exist. Verify model fidelity, controller coverage and simulation-to-deployment boundaries with documented fixtures and vendor requirements. FPGA/HDL workflows remain an underrepresented research direction; research their toolchain licensing and hardware dependencies separately.

priorities.area: Business deployment, planning and data portability
tasks: Compare inventory, accounting, ERP, CRM and invoicing handoffs
Verify scheduling, resource planning and project interchange
Exercise self-hosted backup, restore, upgrade and export paths
priorities.next_evidence: Project planning and operational business software now have sourced records and guides. Next compare deployment effort, edition boundaries, team licensing, import/export completeness and recoverability. Local application pricing, hosted subscription terms and the cost of a full operational deployment are separate claims.

priorities.area: Scientific comparison depth and additional specialist work
tasks: Add peers for groundwater, river hydraulics and stormwater workflows
Research mathematical optimization and constraint solvers
Research screenwriting, storyboarding and production scheduling
priorities.next_evidence: Scientific coverage now includes molecular dynamics, CFD/FEA, hydrology, astronomical capture and video measurement. Several model-specific categories still have one record. Compare like-for-like tasks and validated inputs rather than treating different scientific models as interchangeable. Optimization and production-planning leads require primary-source research before they become recommendations.
